unverified_claims: ~250,000/mo search volume for 'AI browser' / 'agentic browser' / 'Perplexity Comet' / 'ChatGPT Atlas' — aggregate estimate across the category, not a single Semrush/Ahrefs figure
'+60% QoQ' growth_3m — derived from Comet's disclosed 860% YoY agentic-task growth (implied ~60% per quarter compounded); not a directly published quarterly figure
'Comet Assistant burns 10–50x the energy of a classic page load' — order-of-magnitude estimate consistent with LLM-inference-per-action pattern; no primary energy-per-agentic-session study identified
Opera Neon subscriber count — no verified public number as of August 2026; described as 'paid enthusiast segment' rather than a specific MAU figure
notes: Category is roughly 13 months old — first mainstream agentic browser (Comet) launched July 9, 2025 — so growth_5y is expressed as '+∞' consistent with prior new-category reports (agentic-commerce, generative-engine-optimization). growth_1y '+650%' is grounded in Comet's Q1 2025 → Q1 2026 MAU multiple of 7.5x (source #1). Timeline focuses on six category-defining events: Comet launch, Comet free, Atlas + Atlassian/Dia acquisition, Opera Neon public, Chrome-with-Gemini, and the August 2026 double event (EU AI Act enforcement + Atlas retirement). Atlas's absorption into ChatGPT on Aug 9, 2026 is treated as a distribution move, not a retreat, because agentic-browser workflows continue inside the ChatGPT app on the 900M+ WAU base.
